title: Factor F Stops Being a Number Someone Typed
description: ตาราง Factor F เข้ามาอยู่ใน repository เป็นชุดข้อมูลที่ตรวจสอบได้ พร้อมหนังสือเวียนที่ประกาศมัน เลขที่ วันที่ ผู้ออก อัตราดอกเบี้ยที่ประกาศ ค่าเฉลี่ย MLR ที่ใช้ กฎการปัด และ sha256 ของไฟล์ต้นทาง โมดูลที่อ่านชุดข้อมูลนี้ปฏิเสธเมื่อโครงการคิดบนอัตราดอกเบี้ยหรือ VAT ที่ไม่ตรงกับตาราง แทนที่จะหยิบตารางที่ใกล้เคียงมาใช้ และคืนธงบอกเมื่อค่างานอยู่ระหว่างสองแถว แทนที่จะตัดสินแทนผู้มีคุณวุฒิ
scope: extract all 48 tables and 1,644 rows from the 6% circular with an extractor that checks itself before writing
carry the circular that announces the tables: number, date, issuer, the authority it acts under, the MLR survey behind the rate, the rounding rule and the file checksum
refuse a lookup whose loan interest rate or VAT rate does not match the dataset, and say what the dataset holds
return the governing row together with the next row and a flag when a cost of work falls between two printed rows
record that no qualified person has certified the dataset yet, rather than leaving the field absent
reproduce the ปร.4 of the ปุญโญภาส dialysis building to the satang as a test
verification: the extractor verifies that every VAT column equals its factor column times 1.07 within 0.0002, that each work type has exactly twelve tables with distinct advance/retention pairs, one interest rate and one row count, and that irrigation heavy-rain columns increase
unit tests re-check the same invariants through the public module, in every quality gate
unit tests reproduce the real ปร.4: cost of work 2,529,230.20 x 1.3034 = 3,296,598.64, floored to 3,296,500
unit tests confirm the module refuses a 7% project, a 10% VAT project and an advance/retention pair the circular does not publish
pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint and pnpm test pass (161 passed, 33 skipped)
pushed on feature/estimeter-measurement-breakdown and tagged v0.22.0-factor-f-dataset; the Quality Gate run for 069e2aa, which contains this work, passed including the opt-in PostgreSQL suites
rollback: Revert the v0.22.0 commit. The dataset, its module and its tests are additive; nothing reads Factor F yet, so no existing behaviour changes.
constraints: No value enters the dataset that is not printed in the circular. The extractor derives nothing.
The dataset is not certified: reviewedBy is null and the module exposes it, so a caller can refuse to price on an unreviewed table.
Effective date ranges are deliberately absent. ว481 is dated 26 June 2569 while the real project priced on 20 June 2569 already used the 6% table, so an earlier circular exists that we do not have.
Whether a cost of work between two printed rows interpolates or takes the lower row is not decided in code. The table note says interpolate; the audited ปร.4 did not.

items.title: Bring the Factor F tables into the repository as a checked dataset with its circular, checksum and reviewer field
Obtain the 6% circular that preceded ว481 so each Factor F table can carry the dates it was in force
Decide whether a cost of work between two printed rows interpolates or takes the lower row, and record the decision with the authority for it
Have a qualified person certify the Factor F dataset and record the name, so pricing can require a reviewed table
Seed the Factor F table as a versioned dataset carrying its interest rate, effective dates, source checksum and reviewer
Record ประมาณราคาเมื่อวันที่ and ประมาณราคาโดย on the estimate so the sheet header can be filled
Retire takeoff_items.category once headings carry the same meaning
Give price observations a unit, a material and labour split, and a condition, because the official labour schedule prices one item at several rates
Require a human verification step before any OCR-extracted price or factor can be used in a calculation
Enforce capabilities.read on every ESTIMETR read path so the platform kill switch stops reads, not only writes
Order organization selection deterministically before a member can belong to more than one organization
Validate the official source for ปร.4, ปร.5 and ปร.6 against the Comptroller General's Department, which ว499 and ว481 confirm is the issuing authority
Apply GitHub branch protection once the plan upgrade allows it
Give roadmap item ids a single owner: IP-059 was issued twice, in v0.18.0 and again in v0.20.0, for unrelated work
